attribution.title: Former Zeemanshuis, Kadijksplein 17-18, Amsterdam (1856)
attribution.author: Map Recall
attribution.modifications: Original texture-free flat-colour geometry on the 3DBAG LoD2.2 shell (CC BY 4.0) of BAG pand 0363100012164985 (CC0): the dark brick fronts with hardstone courses and white-framed windows on one storey grid, the segment-headed first-floor windows of the Kadijksplein front, the corner towers with round-arched top windows, the entrance surrounds, balconies and white timber surrounds, the ZEEMANS-HUIS and ANNO 1856 boards, the brick portico, concrete cap and glazed penthouse of the south-east tower, read from Gemeente Amsterdam panoramas (CC BY 4.0) and the municipal monument register text. No pixels or meshes imported.
